hero.sub: Computer engineer specialized in JavaScript fullstack development, from resilient backend services to the AI features on top of them.

about.p1: I'm a computer engineer specialized in JavaScript fullstack development, working end-to-end across the stack, designing APIs and data layers, building the interfaces on top, and wiring in the AI that makes them useful.
about.founding: As a founding engineer at Entropy Systems, I've shaped the architecture of our SaaS products for ISO standards auditing from day one. They're now used by ~40 client companies.
about.p2: My work centers on scalable, distributed systems built with TypeScript, Node and Python, with a long-running interest in document tooling and developer-facing libraries.
about.p3: Lately that means shipping AI-powered features: retrieval, LLM orchestration and the production plumbing that keeps them reliable.

bullets: Founding engineer: architected and delivered 3 SaaS products for ISO standards auditing, now used by ~40 client companies, in a small engineering team (3–5 engineers).
Built full-stack features in TypeScript using React, Next.js and Vite on the frontend, with Fastify and Node.js services on the backend.

Designed LLM agent pipelines on AWS Bedrock for document processing, conversational assistants and workflow automation, processing ~2,000 audit documents per month and cutting manual review time by ~60%.
Operated 12 distributed services across AWS and GCP with 99.9% uptime, using event-driven and serverless patterns.
Containerized services with Docker and built CI/CD pipelines that cut deployment time from ~1 hour to ~10 minutes, enabling daily releases.
Led migration of a ~80k-line video analytics codebase from legacy JavaScript to TypeScript, reducing production runtime errors by ~30%.
Introduced Vite and esbuild into the build pipeline, cutting build time from ~3 min to ~20 s.
Partnered with product and design teams to deliver consistent UI behavior across a complex, data-rich surveillance interface.
Led a team of 4 front-end engineers building 5 index and ETF analytics applications, setting engineering standards and driving delivery quality.
Introduced shift-left practices (code reviews, linting and automated testing), raising test coverage from ~10% to ~70%.
Established shared component patterns and a consistent architecture across the applications.
Contributed across the stack, delivering UI features in TypeScript and supporting backend API work in Python.
Built and maintained financial applications for index construction and ETF analytics across frontend, backend and data layers.
Designed asynchronous RabbitMQ workflows ingesting ~1M market-data records per day.
Developed REST APIs and backend services in Python and Node.js, backed by PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Built 3 internal systems used daily by ~200 employees for registration, traceability and collaborator lifecycle management, using Python and Node.js.
Developed front-end interfaces and backend services to support business operations and data tracking workflows.
Deployed and operated services on Linux servers with NGINX as a reverse proxy.

education.detail: Computer engineering degree, with foundations in software engineering, distributed systems and mathematics.
